citation.authors: Lebwohl B, Capiak K, Neugut AI

cited_by.title: Colonoscopy: when to start and how often

record.population: 5,075 adults aged 50 and over having a first screening colonoscopy at one tertiary centre in the US (591 Black, 942 Hispanic, 3,542 white)
record.finding: At least one adenoma was found in 26% of Black patients, 22% of Hispanic and 19% of white patients. Black patients had a higher adenoma rate (risk ratio 1.76) and more advanced adenomas (odds ratio 1.91) than white patients.
record.note: Single centre; ages 50 and over, so it says nothing about 40 to 49.
